products.name: Agent Security Scanner
products.tagline: Scan AI agent code for security vulnerabilities
products.problem: AI agent frameworks have 190+ known security advisories. Developers lack tools to check their code.
products.solution: Vercel serverless tool that analyzes Python/TypeScript agent code for: prompt injection, credential exposure, MCP misconfig, tool vulnerabilities
products.evidence: ArXiv: Agent Audit (2603.22853), AegisUI (2603.05031), OpenClaw taxonomy (2603.27517). GitHub: openclaude 16K stars, gstack 64K stars

products.name: MCP Config Validator
products.problem: MCP servers misconfiguration leads to over-privileged agents
products.solution: Online tool that validates MCP server configs, checks permissions, suggests least-privilege
products.evidence: MCP Registry launched on GitHub March 2026. ArXiv 2603.19469 discusses MCP security

products.name: Function Call Debugger
products.tagline: Debug LLM function calling in real-time
products.problem: Debugging function calls between LLMs and tools is difficult
products.solution: Visual debugger that traces function calls, shows JSON payloads, optimizes prompts
products.evidence: ArXiv: Agentic Tool Use in LLMs (2604.00835). GitHub: CLI-Anything 28K stars

recommendation: Build Agent Security Scanner first - aligns with JWT Inspector product line, strong market demand, 2-3 cycle MVP
